title: Generic response type helper
prompt: Create `src/api/types.ts` that exports `GetPath`, the union of every path of the document that has a GET operation, and a generic type `GetData<Path extends GetPath>`: the type of `data` of a successful `client.GET(path)` for that path (its 200 JSON body). Build both from the generated `paths` type and the openapi-typesafe helper types; do not list paths or shapes by hand.
